verdict.rationale: Formant advertises asking the fleet questions in plain language and receiving 'governed, ML-driven task recommendations' that a human must approve, which is a limited form of NL task expression rather than full autonomous planning and execution. There is no evidence of end-to-end NL-to-robot-task planning/execution without human-in-the-loop, and no SDK/API documentation for triggering arbitrary tasks via natural language. Missing for 10: documented NL task-to-plan pipeline, autonomous execution without approval gating, and developer-facing API/SDK for natural-language task submission.
